parameters.name: conn_id
parameters.description: The connection to run the sensor against

parameters.name: sql
parameters.description: The SQL to run. To pass, it needs to return at least one cell that contains a non-zero / empty string value.

parameters.name: parameters
parameters.description: The parameters to render the SQL query with (optional).

parameters.name: success
parameters.description: Success criteria for the sensor is a Callable that takes the output of selector as the only argument, and returns a boolean (optional).

parameters.name: failure
parameters.description: Failure criteria for the sensor is a Callable that takes the output of selector as the only argument and returns a boolean (optional).

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Function which takes the resulting row and transforms it before it is passed to success or failure (optional). Takes the first cell by default.

parameters.name: fail_on_empty
parameters.description: Explicitly fail on no rows returned.

parameters.name: hook_params
parameters.description: Extra config params to be passed to the underlying hook. Should match the desired hook constructor params.
